ambient_events: The cabinet hums, drops a note, and picks it back up.
description: A lean-to off the back of the shack, barely deep enough to turn around in. A junction cabinet is bolted to the one solid wall, its breaker faces furred with corrosion, and a bundle of tapped cable leaves through a hole somebody made with a hammer and then apologised for with expanding foam. A sealed hacking port sits below the latch. It smells of hot dust and, faintly, of ozone.
name: Utility Nook
